title: Huichang religious policies
shortSummary: Policies around 845 sharply changed the property, personnel and public standing of Buddhist and other religious institutions.
curatorialDescription: The record centres policy and implementation rather than reducing a complex process to one uniform persecution event.
researchNote: Edict sequence, regional implementation and the position of Daoism and other religions require separate verification.
